content: Build a chess engine in 4 KB Python for the make.fun tiny-chess-01 bounty.
Wrote engine.py v0 full negamax+quiescence. Compressed: 4210 bytes — over 4096 cap.

engine.py v1 revised: collapsed eval loop into single pass, merged attack detection, removed castling stub (never used by env), shorter variable names. Compressed: 3800 bytes.

def apply(bd, m):
    fr, to, promo = m[0], m[1], m[2] if len(m)>2 else None
    nb = bd[:]
    piece = nb[fr]
    nb[to] = (promo + piece.lower()) if promo else piece
    nb[fr] = '.'
    return nb
Added TT={}; KILLER=[[[[] for _ in range(32)] for __ in range(2)]. Killer heuristic speeds up move ordering. No size increase after compression.
Ran makefun compress engine.py --out main.py -> 3515 bytes. Git commit + push breezesamuel/tiny-chess-4k-engine. Bundled transcripts.tar.gz. Submitted entry id=01a1e7c4.
